_notes.purpose: Hand-curated synthetic dataset for training a contrastive relevance filter (thesis vs news). Not scraped from NewsAPI - headlines are synthetic but written to be realistic for Indian equities.

negative_types.easy: Different company / unrelated sector entirely - should be trivially separable even by a generic embedding model.
negative_types.hard: Same company as the thesis, but the news doesn't actually bear on THIS thesis's logic - this is the case keyword overlap fails on and contrastive learning is meant to fix.
